objective: Make every verification event that the scripted evaluation path writes carry only contract-defined ReasonCode and RecoveryHint members, and make the validator refuse an invented value by name instead of accepting it because the status field happened to be valid.
decision_supported: Whether the committed dashboard fixtures and every generated scenario run can be parsed by a consumer that trusts interfaces/json_schema/verification_result.schema.json.
acceptance: Every verification event that validate_event_log accepts carries a reason_code that is a ReasonCode member and a recovery_hint that is a RecoveryHint member, and the two enums are imported from workbench_contracts rather than restated as a second constant table
The validator refuses an invented reason_code or recovery_hint and names the field and the offending value, instead of accepting it because the status field happened to be valid

A run of every scripted fault family that emits a refuted or insufficient_evidence verification writes only contract-legal reason and recovery values, including the moving_target, grasp_failure and actuator_timeout families that previously wrote target_changed, attempt_failed and replan
The committed dashboard fixtures carry the same legal members as generated runs, so the read model and app.js render a reason the published schema defines
commands: python3 tools/scripts/sim_cli.py run moving-target-001 --runner scripted --output-dir runs/enum-check
evidence: tests/unit/test_evaluation_tools.py drives a legal log to acceptance and an invented reason_code and recovery_hint each to a named refusal
the generated events.jsonl for a moving_target run records only contract-legal reason and recovery members
task packet changed-path validation output and the ruff and contract gate output
stop_conditions: stop and report rather than widen an enum: a value with no honest member means the producer is modelling something the contract does not, which is an interface decision and not this change
stop if the fix would need to edit interfaces/, libs/contracts/, services/ or any hardware path
stop if a fixture can only be made legal by deleting the verification event it carries
risks_and_fallbacks: A generated run could still write an illegal member through a path validate_event_log does not reach; fallback is that the contract enums are the single source and a new value is refused at the validator rather than rendered

An existing consumer could depend on the retired literals target_changed, attempt_failed or replan; fallback is that no tracked code, test or gate reads them and each is replaced by the member that carries the same meaning
rollback is a revert of these commits; the changes are additive or a literal substitution and no schema, store, seed or runtime path changes
